Strategy: Score favors the bin whose residual is closest to the largest residual minus the item size, so the choice sits one item below the emptiest bin. It differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin is far from that anchor. It may help by leaving the emptiest bin almost untouched while using the next one, or fail because the anchor bin may be an outlier that misleads the target.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = max(bins)
    return [-abs(r - (m - item)) for r in bins]
```
